rationale: The agent verified identity via the user’s email and matched it to a single account before discussing orders. It retrieved both order details with read-only tools, confirmed eligibility, and requested explicit confirmation prior to initiating returns. When the user asked for cross-refunding to opposite payment methods, the agent did not perform that unsupported action; after the user explicitly agreed to proceed with refunds to the original methods, the agent submitted return requests for all items in both orders using the correct original payment methods. Final confirmation reflected tool outputs (status updated to return requested and correct payment methods). No writes were performed without user confirmation, and no unsupported or fabricated order information was stated. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
